titulo.estudio: Lire un dossier complet : Observer les formes
titulo.alumno: Reading several documents together: Vocabulary and forms

intro: Cross-check information from an email, an advert and a timetable to solve an everyday task. Read the French first; open the translation whenever you want to check your understanding.

piezas.titulo: Reading the vocabulary and the forms
texto: Cross-check information from an email, an advert and a timetable to solve an everyday task. Match the subject with the request and check the dates, conditions and actions the message asks you to carry out.
Watch out: compare who writes, which document it refers to and which action or date is still valid. In this passage, «billet» means «ticket».

frases.estudio: L'annonce précise que le billet coûte huit euros et que la réservation est obligatoire.
frases.alumno: The advert states that the ticket costs eight euros and that booking is compulsory.

frases.estudio: Un second message annonce que l'entrée se fera par la porte nord, à cause des travaux.
frases.alumno: A second message says that the entrance will be through the north door because of building work.
